description: Shell script for testing 'git rerere' functionality, including setup, conflict resolution, diff, status, garbage collection, and various edge cases.

methods.name: concat_insert
methods.description: Concatenates early content, provided arguments, and late content to simulate conflict resolution.

methods.name: count_pre_post
methods.description: Counts the number of preimage and postimage files in the rerere cache.

methods.name: merge_conflict_resolve
methods.description: Simulates a merge conflict resolution by creating specific file contents.

methods.name: rerere_gc_custom_expiry_test
methods.description: Tests rerere garbage collection with custom expiry times.
